condA.text:
When each sign-out sheet shows

A1 only when the server has confirmed the last sync and nothing is waiting (no pending changes, no open conflicts). Otherwise A2. A1 starts no sync: Cancel only closes it (Android Back or a tap outside, Mac/web Esc, all cancel; Mac/web focus starts on Cancel).

A2's last sentence is "They stay on this device under this account." (2026-11-09). The fuller "Until then, no one else who uses Dottoday on this device can see them." replaces it only after the isolation fixes I1–I8 in docs/cr-160-verification.md pass: reminders already shown, web timers and pushes, widgets and Wind Down timer, backups, brain dumps and recent searches, undo and open editors, the action queue.

condG.text: G1 shows only for guest tasks made since this device was last signed out, in the current guest session. "Bring them in" also needs the "I made these tasks myself" box: a choice, never proof of ownership. Tasks made before the last sign-out get G1b instead: they stay on this device and can't be brought in. No preview of guest tasks after sign-in.

condD.text: Locked copy (D1 Keep and the kept-copy row) is a conditional proposal only. It would need owner-bound protection (an encrypted copy opened by a recovery passphrase set while signed in), designed, implemented and tested first. A device passcode never proves who owned a deleted account. Interim on every platform: export while signed in, then delete and remove the copy.
